name: Iced spice biscuits
author: The Wickham family
steps: Sift in flour, spice and salt.
Cut into shapes with cutters, cook at 180C for 12 minutes.
You can also stick two together with raspberry jam and ice the top one with pale pink coloured icing.
Comments: Very nice as Christmas gifts.

culture.text: A biscuit is a flour-based baked food item. Biscuits are typically hard, flat, and unleavened. They are usually sweet and may be made with sugar, chocolate, icing, jam, ginger, or cinnamon. Savoury biscuits are called crackers or biscuits for cheese.
